Title: WCAG 2.2 Compliance
What I checked: Verify the refreshed HIVE platform meets WCAG 2.2-aligned accessibility expectations across key user actions (navigation, filtering, search, viewing outputs)
Issue description: There are multiple non-compliances against the WCAG 2.2 standard.
Notes: It may be the case that this requirement has been deprioritised in weekly progress meetings with DfT. If so please refer to those written agreement/confirmations.
Our position and what is built: UK public sector legal baseline is WCAG 2.1 AA; we targeted WCAG 2.2 AA per WP1. Full implementation pass documented in spec (23 Mar 2026). Automated pa11y: zero critical; serious findings were overwhelmingly six root contrast tokens repeated across cards — not structural keyboard/ARIA failures.
Changes since Loren's review: Contrast tokens darkened (themes.ts and components); scope on table headers; post-fix pa11y ~91% reduction on handbook routes (see accessibility audit).
Open actions / reviewer check: Reviewer: re-run pa11y/axe on staging and flag any non-contrast violations.
